body: > Prior to [c78c3ba](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/c78c3ba894ab3b80079a6249b35d047c6fd0a6c1) these errors didn't pop up since we were manually freeing each pipeline before the corresponding shader, but that is an antipattern in our codebase. We should trust shaders to clean up their dependent pipelines We can't exactly rely on that trust here. There's another scenario where pipeline compilation could be ongoing and it could be using the modules allocated by the shader in the driver. The correct way to use the pipeline deferred class is indeed to wait and free the pipelines before the shader is destroyed. This check alone only fixes the stale reference, but the bigger problem is the possibility of a race condition during shutdown if we don't check on the deferred pipeline class first. The correct operation here is to call the free on PipelineDeferred before the shader is destroyed, as that ensures the task is finished before the module is freed. In short, anything that directly affects the Shader the pipeline compilation is using should come after the pipelines are freed. The pattern is present throughout the original PR that adds the class because of this scenario. We should just add the proper frees before the shader if it was missed somewhere. Were you able to determine which class triggered this when investigating https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/113495?

> The correct operation here is to call the free on PipelineDeferred before the shader is destroyed, as that ensures the task is finished before the module is freed.

> In short, anything that directly affects the Shader the pipeline compilation is using should come after the pipelines are freed. The pattern is present throughout the original PR that adds the class because of this scenario. We should just add the proper frees before the shader if it was missed somewhere.

Ooooh that's brutal.

I think we should still leave this check in place though since we should never attempt to free invalid pipelines. Or do you think it would be preferable to leave out the check so we at least get some sort of error if people forget to free the PipelineDeferred before freeing the shader?

> Were you able to determine which class triggered this when investigating https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/113495?
